title: Operation Gaja in Karnataka: People protest in Mudigere, observe bandh

ai.summary: Residents in Mudigere taluk staged protests against Operation Gaja, the Forest Department's plan to move wild elephants from Hassan district to Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary, calling for a bandh that saw shops closed and schools holiday.

facts.claim: Residents of Mudigere taluk in Chikkamagaluru district staged protests and called for a bandh on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) against Operation Gaja, the Forest Department’s drive to move wild elephants from Hassan district towards the Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary.
facts.quote: Residents of Mudigere taluk in Chikkamagaluru district staged protests and called for a bandh on Wednesday (November 25, 2026) against Operation Gaja, the Forest Department’s drive to move wild elephants from Hassan district towards the Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary.

facts.claim: The bandh call has continued received a good response so far. A majority of the shops remained closed. Schools in the town have declared a holiday.
facts.quote: The bandh call has continued received a good response so far. A majority of the shops remained closed. Schools in the town have declared a holiday.

facts.claim: The protesters gathered in front of the office of the subdivision of Forest Department in the town. They raised slogans against the Forest Department, Excise and Hassan district minister K.M. Shivalinge Gowda for the drive.
facts.quote: The protesters gathered in front of the office of the subdivision of Forest Department in the town. They raised slogans against the Forest Department, Excise and Hassan district minister K.M. Shivalinge Gowda for the drive.

facts.claim: The Operation Gaja was launched after two people were killed in separate elephant attacks in Belur taluk. The department plans to relocate about 56 elephants.
facts.quote: The Operation Gaja was launched after two people were killed in separate elephant attacks in Belur taluk. The department plans to relocate about 56 elephants.

facts.claim: About 39 elephants have already reached Mudigere taluk, in two herds near Dunduga and Makonahalli.
facts.quote: About 39 elephants have already reached Mudigere taluk, in two herds near Dunduga and Makonahalli.

facts.claim: Farmers, coffee growers and political representatives said the region should not become the route for the drive, and want the elephants taken back.
facts.quote: Farmers, coffee growers and political representatives said the region should not become the route for the drive, and want the elephants taken back.

ai.background_note: Operation Gaja is the Forest Department's drive to move wild elephants from Hassan district to Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary following two deaths in Belur taluk.
